items.title: Jim Hall — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: And I think I told you I did a duet… It was his concert someplace upstate.

ctx.x: Oh. Well, they’re so different from one another, I think part of it, and… That’s another funny thing. Scofield, especially. He, he’s in that group that plays really loud now, with amps. And I think I told you I did a duet… It was his concert someplace upstate. I forget where. And most of it was okay. And then he would pick up this electric… And I couldn’t stand next to the guy and do this, so I just said… but… I forget what my train of thought is here, but yeah, I just wanted people to play differently and guitar…
Do these guys think conceptually musically differently than you do or…?
